A PLAIN POWER LED off the module's own rail, like every other Eurorack module's. It used to be driven by a presence comparator that watched the breath line - that comparator is DELETED, and with it the only thing in the module that tried to know whether the instrument was there. Health reporting belongs in the instrument, which has a display, a web app and the actual data. With LT1641-1 latching off on a fault, this still says why the instrument went dark
